public.title: Cumulative Sums
public.description: Given an array of safe integers, return a new array whose element at each index is the sum of all input elements up to that index. The input has at most 1000 elements, each between -1000 and 1000. Return an empty array for empty input.
hints: Keep a running sum while visiting values from left to right.
public.attribution: Original exercise authored for Bekor, 2026. No third-party exercise material used.

explanation: Maintain a running sum initialized to zero. Add each value and append the new sum to a result array. This visits each element once and returns a distinct array.
